Design scope

What the architecture covers

Plan a retail building that is easy to see, enter, browse and operate. Shop frontage, anchors, circulation, parking and loading work together from the start.

01Tenant and anchor layoutOrganize unit sizes, anchor positions and shared spaces around the commercial brief.
02Shop frontageGive retailers clear visibility, workable widths and consistent signage zones.
03Customer circulationPlan entrances, corridors, stairs and lifts around intuitive movement.
04Parking and drop-offCoordinate vehicles, pedestrians and arrival points around peak use.
05Loading and service routesKeep deliveries, waste and back-of-house movement away from customers.
06Services coordinationAllow for power, cooling, fire systems, drainage and vertical risers.

Eight-step process

From brief to buildable drawings

Each stage closes the important decisions before the next one begins.

01

Brief and site analysis

Confirm the project brief, review the site and record the constraints that shape the design.

02

Concept planning

Test layout, zoning, access and movement before the architectural form is fixed.

03

Form and 3D studies

Develop the exterior character and review key views, proportions and materials.

04

Design development

Resolve dimensions, openings, levels, materials and the key technical decisions.

05

Working drawings

Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations and the agreed construction details.

06

Authority submission

Develop the required architectural set around the relevant approval process.

07

Operations and specialist systems

Coordinate structure, MEP, fire strategy, signage zones and loading requirements.

08

Final handover

Issue the agreed drawing package for pricing, coordination and construction.

Architecture fees

A clear range before the proposal

The fee covers architectural design and drawings. Construction, interior design and fit-out are separate unless they are added to the brief.

IncludedConcept planning, tenant layout, facade studies, working drawings and coordination.
Final feeThe final proposal reflects built area, store mix, parking, loading, approvals and specialist input.
Separate costsGovernment charges, surveys and third-party specialist fees are confirmed separately where needed.
Indicative design feePKR 1M–3M

The final proposal reflects built area, store mix, parking, loading, approvals and specialist input.
